In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 - Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 - Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 - Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 - Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 - Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

 - 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 - You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 - You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 - You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 - You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 - You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 - You like days that look different from each other

 - Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.




AI AT LENDABLE

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.




YOUR TEAM

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

 - A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

 - A data science team building models specific to the US business

 - A credit risk team

 - A growth team

 - An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.







LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

 - Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

 - Top-tier private health insurance

 - Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time and move quickly:

 1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

 2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.



What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

 - Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

 - Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

 - Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

 - Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

 - Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

 - Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

 - Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

 - Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

 - Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

 - Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling
   
   

What we’re looking for

 - Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

 - Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

 - Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

 - Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

 - Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

 - Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

 - Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

 - Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities
   
   

Highly desirable

 - Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

 - Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

 - Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

 - 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

   - 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

About the role

As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions.

If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you:

 - Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do

 - The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision

 - Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs

 - Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding.

 - The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed.

Also, even better if you have:

 - Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment

 - An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015

 - An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards

 - The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints

 - Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Your team’s objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

How you’ll impact those objectives

The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution.

 - You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers and prioritising cases where appropriate to be highly productive and efficient, and to maintain the required level of performance against our KPI minimum standards.

 - You will champion using our AI tools and technology to bring a first class service to our customers.

 - You will work well under pressure and be adaptable, being able to turn your hand to other areas of operational need, as the business may require.

 - You will ensure that you follow our complaint handling standards, have good record keeping skills and ensure that all decisions made are backed up with demonstrable evidence and rationale.

 - You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business.

 - You will be responsible for communicating with the complainant, either in writing or by phone and will enjoy finding solutions to issues raised, managing customer expectations and handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism.

 - You will have a good knowledge and understanding of FCA regulation as well as DISP complaint handling rules and guidance.

 - You will also ensure that you maintain up to date knowledge of Lendable’s products through effective use and review of policies, procedures and business tools made available to you.

 - You will have strong letter writing skills, being able to create professional final response letters which break down complex issues into comprehensible information for consumers to understand.

 - You will also have a sound moral compass, speaking up where necessary to ensure that good customer outcomes are always at the heart of what we do, striving to resolve complaints without the need for the customer to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service, and ensuring you are applying any learnings from both internal and FOS complaints to future complaint cases.

The Interview Process

 - A quick phone call with one of the team

 - An exercise to demonstrate your ability to resolve complaints

 - An assessment to evidence your knowledge of FCA regulations and DISP complaint handling rules/guidance.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Own the mobile test strategy:

 - Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

 - Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

 - Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.
   
   

Build reliable E2E automation:

 - Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

 - Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

 - Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.
   
   

Bring AI into the SDLC:

 - Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

 - Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

 - Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.
   
   

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

 - Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

 - Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

 - Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

 - 2-3+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

 - Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

 - Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

 - Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

 - Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).
   
   

Desirable:

 - Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

 - Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

 - API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 - Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 - Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 - Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 - Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 - Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

 - 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 - You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 - You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 - You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 - You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 - You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 - You like days that look different from each other

 - Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.




AI AT LENDABLE

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.




YOUR TEAM

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

 - A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

 - A data science team building models specific to the US business

 - A credit risk team

 - A growth team

 - An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.







LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

 - Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

 - Top-tier private health insurance

 - Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time and move quickly:

 1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

 2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

 3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.

 - 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

 - Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

 - Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

 - Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

 - AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

 - Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

 - Bonus:

   - Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools
   
   - Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

 - Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

 - Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

 - Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

 - Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

 - Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

 - Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

As our Senior Performance Marketing Manager for the US and Mexico, you'll be the operational engine behind our growth in two new markets. Reporting to the Head of Growth, you'll own the tactical campaign management of our digital acquisition across the US and MX - standing up channels from scratch, finding what works, and scaling the winners. You'll manage significant budgets on Meta, TikTok and Google Ads, identify and iterate on winning creative concepts, and optimise conversion funnels for two very different markets.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities others miss, and gets genuinely excited about turning creative concepts into scaled winners - in markets where there's no existing playbook to lean on.  - Deep hands-on Meta, Google Ads and TikTok campaign management experience, managing multi-million annual budgets

 - A strong understanding of effective hooks, messaging and creative formats for social media

 - Familiarity with attribution modelling and incrementally testing concepts

 - A strong analytical mindset; SQL proficiency preferred

 - Comfortable creating and working with AI tools to enhance productivity and analysis

 - Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building in new audiences and markets without an established playbook

Desirable:

 - Experience launching or scaling acquisition in the US and/or Mexican markets

 - Spanish language skills valued but not essential

 - Experience standing up a digital channel or market from scratch

 - Experience in financial services or other regulated consumer categories


YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU'RE:

 - An owner: you see digital marketing opportunities and execute them without detailed instructions

 - Creative and analytical: you balance intuition with data-driven decision making

 - Detail-oriented: you catch performance patterns others miss and build robust testing processes

 - Energised by greenfield: you'd rather build the engine in a new market than take the reigns from someone else

 - Growth-minded: you're here to learn, improve and take on bigger challenges


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Channel Strategy & Scaling:

 - Own the D2C acquisition strategy for the US and Mexico across paid social and search, driving volume and efficiency against ambitious incremental CAC targets

 - Lead the launch and scale of new high-potential channels while ensuring Meta, Google and TikTok maintain a best-in-class foundation from day one

 - Establish what works in two distinct markets and build the repeatable playbook to scale it

Creative Engine:

 - Drive the performant creative engine: translate customer insights and winning patterns to inform clear, data-informed briefs for our external creator network, ensuring high-performing video content is produced at speed

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Marketing is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Marketing to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.  Addressed direct mail is the core today, and you’ll have the scope to extend into other formats.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct marketing roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build and extend a  channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.



What we’re looking for:

Essential:

 - 5+ years in direct marketing, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

 - A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

 - Commercial ownership: you build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, and judge results on a marginal CAC basis rather than vanity metrics.

 - Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

 - Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

 - A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

 - Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

 - Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

 - The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

 - Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

 - A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

 - Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.
   
   

Desirable:

 - Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

 - Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

 - Experience building a channel or function from scratch

 - Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team
   
   

You’re a good fit if you’re:

 - Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

 - Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

 - A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

 - Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

 - Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s



What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

 - Own the direct marketing strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

 - Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

 - Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

 - Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

 - Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

 - Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

 - Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

 - Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

 - Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, so sharp prioritisation is central to the job. The role also has a real technical edge.  - Taking products and channel improvements from problem definition through to launch and iteration, owning both the product and technical decisions alongside Engineering

 - Defining the metrics that matter and making the commercial trade-offs between growth, retention, cost and customer experience, and making sure performance is measurable end to end, from tracking and data flows through to dashboards the wider business can trust

 - Running an experimentation programme: writing clear hypotheses, designing A/B tests, and using SQL and our data to measure true incremental impact

 - Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

 - Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

 - Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

 - 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

 - Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

 - Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

 - A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features

 - Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics

 - Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

 - Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

 - Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

 - Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

 - Strong account / relationship management skills

 - Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

 - Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

 - Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

 - Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

 - Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

 - Experience in fintech or financial services

 - Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

 - Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

 - Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

 - Some deal structuring experience

 - Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive


YOU’RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU’RE:

 - A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

 - A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

 - Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

 - A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

 - Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

 - Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

 - Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

 - Mentor and support a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

 - Represent the partnerships function in senior leadership and budget reviews

 - Analyse performance at channel, product and customer segment level to identify opportunities to improve pricing, product and conversion efficiency

 - Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

 - Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

 - Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

 - Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues

Essential

 - Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

 - The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

 - Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

 - Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

 - Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

 - Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

 - Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

 - A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how



PERKS & BENEFITS

 - More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

 - Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

 - Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

 - Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

 - Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.

APMs at Lendable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.

You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

 - Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

 - Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

 - Using data to drive improvements: Work with Credit and Data Science to identify opportunities and build models to improve payment and servicing outcomes. Build dashboards to track key metrics and measure the impact of what we launch.

 - Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

 - Taking products from idea to launch: Working across Engineering, Data Science and Operations to understand the impact of new features, coordinate their rollout and make sure they work for both customers and the business.

 - Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Don't worry if you don't meet every single one of the criteria. We'd love to hear from great candidates who are curious, proactive and excited to learn.

 - Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

 - Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

 - Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

 - Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

 - Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

 - AI-native: You're already experimenting with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and are excited to see how far they can take you.

 - Hands-on: You're happy to roll up your sleeves and pick up the small jobs. In a lean product team, no task is beneath your attention.

 - Adaptable: You enjoy variety and like that no two days look quite the same.

 - Bonus: Experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup.
   
   


AI AT LENDABLE

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - A quick chat with someone from our Product team to see if the role is a good match

 - A 15 minute cognitive assessment

 - A take home task; a practical product challenge to complete in your own time

 - Task debrief with the product team

 - Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and UK Loans MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager
   
   


LOCATION

This position is a hybrid role based in London, please note we're unable to provide sponsorship for this position

Operations is roughly half of Lendable's people. Central Ops Engineering is a small product engineering team that builds the tooling to help keep back office operations lean and efficient, while maintaining good customer outcomes.

We're hiring a senior product engineer who can own and deliver large problems in that space. You'll build the internal web apps and automations that agents use every day, and help shape how the team uses AI coding tools.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Current problems include:

 - Complaints: we've already made handling much more efficient for officers, and are continuing to push on this.

 - Fraud and Fincrime: putting the signals an investigator needs into one place.

 - Quality assurance: using AI to review far more calls than a QA team can sample, and directing coaching to the agents who need it.

We use Claude Code, Codex, Augment and other AI tools every day. They've tripled our productivity, and we want you to help decide where we take that next. You'll hand real work to coding agents and take responsibility for what ships.

You'll work directly with ops agents and their managers, and with Product. Data Science and Analytics own the models and prompt engineering, and you'll build the tools that put their work in front of agents.




WHO YOU ARE

 - An experienced product engineer with a strong track record of delivering practical, full-stack solutions on modern technology

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and focused on business outcomes, looking beyond the stated requirements to address the underlying problem

 - Experienced in shaping team ways of working and mentoring other engineers

This is what we use today, to give you a feel for the work. If your tech stack is different, we'd still like to hear from you: we've successfully onboarded engineers from different stacks in the past.

 - Backend: Python and FastAPI

 - Frontend: React, Next.js and Tailwind

 - Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo and Terraform

 - Data: SQL & Snowflake

 - Patterns: Domain Driven Design, message-driven systems and event sourcing

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



About the Role

Lendable is a high-growth FinTech building its security operations capability deliberately. As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you will triage and respond to security alerts, help improve the quality of the detections behind them, and lead the response when a security event becomes an incident.

You will investigate alerts and escalations from our MSSP, tune our monitoring so that it finds more of what matters and less of what doesn’t, and act as a trusted Incident Commander for security incidents, from declaration through to post-incident review. You will work with Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders, and you will be credible with all of them.

AI is used widely across the business, in how we build software, run operations and serve customers, and that changes both what security incidents look like and how quickly we can respond to them. You will use AI and automation as a normal part of your work, and you will be able to investigate and respond to incidents where AI tooling is the cause, the target or the route in.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with hands-on SOC experience and a track record of commanding incidents.


What You’ll Be Doing

1. Alert Triage & Monitoring

 - Triage and investigate alerts across our SIEM, EDR, identity and cloud tooling, taking escalations from our MSSP’s first-line team.

 - Reduce false positives and alert fatigue by tuning detection rules, thresholds and suppressions.

 - Utilise AI and automation to speed up triage, enrichment and response, and to remove repetitive manual work from the analyst workflow.

2. Incident Command & Response

 - Command security incidents, coordinating technical response, decision-making and communications across Engineering, IT, Legal, Risk and senior stakeholders. Give clear, timely updates to executives during live incidents.

 - Lead or support technical investigation and containment across endpoint, identity and cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, including incidents involving AI use, such as prompt injection, or credentials exposed through AI-generated code.

 - Run blameless post-incident reviews, track actions to closure, and feed lessons back into detection, playbooks and controls.

 - Take part in the out-of-hours on-call rota.

3. Operational Reporting & Assurance

 - Track and report SecOps metrics that reflect reality, such as alert quality, time to triage, time to contain, incident volumes and root causes.

 - Maintain accurate incident records and evidence in our incident management platform to support audit and assurance activity.

 - Build working relationships with Engineering, Platform and IT Systems so that incident response is practised before it is needed.


What We’re Looking For

 - Proven incident command: Demonstrable experience leading significant security incidents as Incident Commander or lead responder, from declaration to resolution and review. You can describe incidents you have run, the decisions you made and what you changed afterwards.

 - Technical investigation skills: Solid hands-on SOC/DFIR experience, including log analysis, endpoint and identity investigation, and cloud incident response in AWS or GCP.

 - AI fluency: You understand how AI use creates security risk, including data exposure, agent misuse and AI-assisted attacks, and you can investigate and contain incidents that involve it.

 - AI-first ways of working: You already use AI and automation to speed up your own work, whether in investigation, enrichment, detection engineering or reporting, and you can judge when to trust the output and when to check it.

 - Composure and influence: You stay calm and structured under pressure, and can direct engineers and senior stakeholders without formal authority over them.

 - Communication: You can brief a senior leader in plain language during a live incident, and write a post-incident report that an engineer, an auditor and a board member can each use.

 - Pragmatism: You understand that security supports a business moving quickly, and you balance risk, speed and proportionality in your decisions.

 - Regulated environment awareness (desirable): Experience in financial services or another regulated sector, including incident reporting and evidence expectations.

 - Certifications (desirable, not required): GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, or equivalent practical experience.

 - A quick phone call with one of the talent team

 - A Hiring Manager call with our Head of InfoSec

 - Technical Interview with two of the team 

 - Final stage interview with our VP of Engineering

 - Own joiner, mover and leaver processes across all locations, making sure they are secure, auditable and efficient
